analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 진입 후 횡보 중이며, MACD 히스토그램은 악화 지속. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 0.76으로 거래량 위축. 현재가 72,945원은 스윙 지지선 72,060원에 근접. 변동성 대비 손절폭 확보 어려움.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI is hovering after entering oversold territory, and MACD histogram continues to worsen. [모멘텀 지표]

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 관망 조건: RSI 50 이상 회복 및 MACD 개선 확인
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]

· Position relative to SMA100/200 (100,599 KRW/101,112 KRW): below long-term trend, maintaining strong weakness
· 52-week position (34.6%) + current price level approaching historical low range
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (36.5→35.0) + entered oversold territory, downward momentum continues
· MACD histogram trajectory (-113.4659→-192.1026) + worsening continues, strengthening bearish trend
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 70,463 KRW) + band width at 28.88%
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (72,060 KRW) + approaching, below Pivot S1 (63,872 KRW)
· Swing resistance (86,590 KRW) + potential for mid-term trend reversal upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (maintaining 71,505 KRW low): sideways phase continues
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.76x) + contraction in movement reliability
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + conditions for entry: confirmation of RSI recovery above 50 and MACD improvement
